contract_kind: bounded source contract, not completed implementation/inventory

event.reason: View refresh conditionally persists a snapshot and check rows; successful application requires client invalidation.
event.producer: ghsnapshot.Manager.worker -> process -> applySnapshot -> Handler.broadcastPRSnapshotApplied; background job, GET is trigger only

payload.linked_issue_ids: UUID string array from ListIssueIDsForPullRequest, possibly empty

event.scope: PR workspaceID; actorType system, actorID empty in Go; no task/chat scope. Private audience intersects membership of all linked private projects; unresolved projects retain workspace fanout; resolution errors drop.
event.transaction: Per PR Begin -> head-guarded snapshot UPDATE -> check DELETE/INSERT -> Commit -> optional onApplied. Guard miss/errors emit nothing. Go has a post-commit publication gap. Python requires durable outbox append in the same transaction as snapshot/check writes, with after-commit retryable delivery; no append on rollback/guard miss. This producer is not implemented here.
event.consumer: Bus SubscribeAll -> workspace or private workspace-member scope -> authenticated websocket subscribers -> frontend pull_request prefix handler invalidates [github,pull-requests]; active issue list refetches.
